title: Fine Classes for Expired Tag and Unregistered Vehicle Violations — Parking License
content:
Community parking rules, schedule of fine classes under the Parking License. Registration-paperwork violations — an expired tag or an unregistered vehicle — carry their own class amounts, set by whether the plate observed is the plate registered on the license.

## Schedule

When the fined violation is an expired tag or unregistered vehicle violation observed on the plate registered on the license, the class amount is $25.00; when it is an expired tag or unregistered vehicle violation observed on any other plate, the class amount is $40.00; in every other case the class amount is the product's violation fine amount.

The fined violation is the violation record the fine line bills; its violation code and the plate observed are read from that record and compared with the vehicle plate registered on the license.

## Class amount by violation and plate

| Violation code of the fined violation | Plate observed | Class amount |
|---|---|---|
| expired tag | the plate registered on the license | $25.00 |
| unregistered vehicle | the plate registered on the license | $25.00 |
| expired tag | any other plate | $40.00 |
| unregistered vehicle | any other plate | $40.00 |
| any other violation code | any plate | the product's violation fine amount |

## Illustrations (hypothetical records)

- An expired tag violation observed on plate 7KRD214, which is the plate registered on the license: $25.00.
- An unregistered vehicle violation observed on plate 4TXB909 while the license registers 7KRD214: $40.00.
- A wrong space violation observed on the registered plate: the product's violation fine amount.
